savepoint.screen.title: Savepoints
savepoint.msg.only_singleplayer: Savepoint only works in singleplayer worlds (including LAN hosts).
savepoint.msg.no_permission: Only the world owner or an operator can use Savepoint.
savepoint.msg.cooldown: Wait %s s before the next savepoint or revert.
savepoint.msg.busy_backup: A full backup is being written. Try again in a moment.
savepoint.msg.pruned: Removed %s old savepoint(s) to stay within the disk budget.
savepoint.msg.pin_hover: Keep this savepoint; it is never deleted automatically
savepoint.msg.backup_offer: Want a full world backup too? %s
savepoint.msg.backup_hover: Write a complete copy of the world as a zip file
savepoint.msg.backup_none: There is no savepoint to back up yet. Create one first.
savepoint.msg.backup_running: A full backup is already running.
savepoint.msg.backup_started: Writing a full backup of "%s" in the background...
savepoint.msg.ambiguous: More than one savepoint matches "%s". Use the id in brackets:
savepoint.msg.revert_owner_only: Only the world owner (the host) can revert.
savepoint.msg.revert_no_client: Revert needs the Savepoint mod on the client as well.
savepoint.msg.revert_undo_failed: Revert cancelled, nothing was changed. The safety savepoint could not be made: %s
savepoint.msg.revert_target_pruned: Revert cancelled, nothing was changed. "%s" was removed to make room for the safety savepoint; raise the disk budget.
savepoint.msg.revert_starting: Reverting to "%s". Your current state was saved as [%s] (undo with /savepoint revert undo).
savepoint.revert.title: Reverting to %s...
savepoint.revert.undo_hover: Go back to how the world was before this revert
savepoint.revert.done: Reverted to "%s". Undo with /savepoint revert undo
savepoint.revert.toast_done_body: Back at "%s". Undo with /savepoint revert undo
savepoint.revert.cancelled: Revert cancelled. The world was not changed.
savepoint.revert.failed: Revert failed, your world was left exactly as it was before the revert started: %s
savepoint.revert.stranded_title: Savepoint could not reopen your world
savepoint.revert.stranded_body: The revert did not complete and the world was left unchanged, but it could not be reopened automatically: %s. Open it from the world list.
savepoint.revert.stranded_after_ok: The revert finished, but the world could not be reopened automatically: %s. Open it from the world list. To undo, use /savepoint revert undo.
